invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Option, as it is created by a new executor call.
indexInstantTime is passed to the executor and required for scheduling, so it is expected to be non-null.
partitionsToIndex is provided as an argument and required by the executor, so it is expected to be non-null.
partitionPaths is also required by the executor and expected to be non-null.
HoodieEngineContext is a required argument for the executor; should never be null at this program point.
